title: God's Covenant with Noah

questions.question: What was the sign of God's covenant with Noah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:13: "I have set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant."

questions.question: What command did God give Noah after the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:1: "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth."

questions.question: What did God promise never to do again?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:11: "Never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood."

questions.question: How long did Noah live after the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:28: Noah lived 350 years after the flood.

questions.question: How old was Noah when he died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:29: "All the days of Noah were 950 years, and he died."

questions.question: What dietary restriction did God give after the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:4: "you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood."

questions.question: What did Noah plant after the flood?
What happened to Noah after he drank wine?
options: He became drunk and lay uncovered
questions.correctAnswer: He became drunk and lay uncovered
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:21: "He drank of the wine and became drunk and lay uncovered in his tent."

questions.question: What did Shem and Japheth do when they learned of Noah's nakedness?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:23: They walked backward and covered him without seeing his nakedness.

questions.question: What is the penalty for murder according to Genesis 9?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:6: "Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man shall his blood be shed."

questions.question: Which of Noah's sons saw his nakedness?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:22: "Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father."

questions.question: Who was cursed because of Ham's actions?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:25: "Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be."

questions.question: What blessing did Noah give to Shem?
options: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem
questions.correctAnswer: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:26: "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem."

questions.question: What blessing did Noah give to Japheth?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:27: "May God enlarge Japheth, and let him dwell in the tents of Shem."

questions.question: Why was man given authority to eat meat after the flood?
options: God gave every moving thing as food
questions.correctAnswer: God gave every moving thing as food
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:3: "Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you."

key_verse_text: 'I have set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.'
